pub type PAdicTokenizer {
  PAdicTokenizer(base: Int, levels: Int, buffer: BitArray, cache: List(#(String, List(Int))))
}

pub fn new_p_adic_tokenizer(base: Int, levels: Int) -> PAdicTokenizer {
  PAdicTokenizer(base, levels, bit_array.new(8192), [])
}

pub fn normalize_utf8(input: String) -> String {
  input
  |> string.to_graphemes
  |> list.map(fn(grapheme) {
    case grapheme {
      "á" -> "a"
      "é" -> "e"
      "í" -> "i"
      "ó" -> "o"
      "ú" -> "u"
      "ö" -> "o"
      "ü" -> "u"
      "ő" -> "o"
      "ű" -> "u"
      _ -> grapheme
    }
  })
  |> string.concat
}

pub fn haar_wavelet_decompose(signal: List(Float), level: Int) -> #(List(Float), List(Float)) {
  case signal {
    [] -> #([], [])
    [x] -> #([x / 2.0], [x / 2.0])
    [x, y] -> #([(x + y) / 2.0], [(x - y) / 2.0])
    xs -> {
      let mid = list.length(xs) / 2
      let left = list.take(xs, mid)
      let right = list.drop(xs, mid)
      let #(low_left, high_left) = haar_wavelet_decompose(left, level - 1)
      let #(low_right, high_right) = haar_wavelet_decompose(right, level - 1)
      #(list.append(low_left, low_right), list.append(high_left, high_right))
    }
  }
}

pub fn walsh_hadamard_transform(input: BitArray, dim: Int) -> BitArray {
  case dim {
    1 -> input
    n -> {
      let half = n / 2
      let even = bit_array.slice(input, 0, half)
      let odd = bit_array.slice(input, half, half)
      let even_t = walsh_hadamard_transform(even, half)
      let odd_t = walsh_hadamard_transform(odd, half)
      let plus = bit_array.concat(even_t, odd_t)
      let minus = bit_array.concat(even_t, bit_array.xor(odd_t, bit_array.new(half, 1)))
      bit_array.concat(plus, minus)
    }
  }
}

pub fn bitplane_slice(data: BitArray, planes: Int) -> List(BitArray) {
  list.range(0, planes - 1)
  |> list.map(fn(plane) {
    let shifted = bit_array.shift_right(data, plane * 8)
    bit_array.and(shifted, bit_array.new(bit_array.length(data), 1))
  })
}

pub fn p_adic_pad(input: List(Int), target_len: Int, base: Int) -> List(Int) {
  let current_len = list.length(input)
  case current_len >= target_len {
    True -> input
    False -> {
      let pad_len = target_len - current_len
      let pad_value = list.repeat(0, pad_len)
      list.append(input, pad_value)
    }
  }
}

pub fn polyphase_decompose(input: List(Int), phases: Int, base: Int) -> List(List(Int)) {
  list.range(0, phases - 1)
  |> list.map(fn(phase) {
    input
    |> list.filter(fn(idx) { idx % phases == phase })
  })
}

pub fn tokenize_batch(inputs: List(String), tokenizer: PAdicTokenizer) -> List(List(Int)) {
  inputs
  |> list.map(fn(input) {
    let normalized = normalize_utf8(input)
    let graphemes = string.to_graphemes(normalized)
    let codes = graphemes
    |> list.map(string.utf8_byte_length)
    |> list.map(fn(len) { len % tokenizer.base })
    let wavelet = haar_wavelet_decompose(codes |> list.map(int.to_float), tokenizer.levels)
    |> tuple.second
    |> list.map(fn(v) { float.to_int(round(v)) % tokenizer.base })
    let bitplanes = bitplane_slice(bit_array.from_list(wavelet), 8)
    |> list.at(0)
    |> bit_array.to_list
    |> polyphase_decompose(128, tokenizer.base)
    |> list.at(0)
    |> p_adic_pad(131072, tokenizer.base)
  })
}

pub fn detokenize_batch(tokens: List(List(Int)), tokenizer: PAdicTokenizer) -> List(String) {
  tokens
  |> list.map(fn(token_list) {
    let reconstructed = polyphase_decompose(token_list, 128, tokenizer.base)
    |> list.reverse
    |> list.flatten
    let bitplanes = list.range(0, 7)
    |> list.map(fn(p) { bit_array.from_list(reconstructed) })
    let wavelet_inv = walsh_hadamard_transform(bitplanes |> list.at(0), 131072)
    let inv_haar = haar_wavelet_decompose(bit_array.to_list(wavelet_inv) |> list.map(int.to_float), tokenizer.levels)
    |> tuple.first
    |> list.map(fn(v) { int.to_float(v) })
    let chars = inv_haar
    |> list.map(fn(val) { val |> float.round |> float.to_int |> char.from_int })
    |> list.filter(ok)
    |> list.map(result.unwrap)
    string.from_chars(chars)
  })
}

pub fn cache_tokenize(tokenizer: PAdicTokenizer, input: String) -> PAdicTokenizer {
  case list.key_find(tokenizer.cache, input) {
    Ok(tokens) -> tokenizer
    Error(Nil) -> {
      let tokens = tokenize_batch([input], tokenizer) |> list.at(0)
      let new_cache = list.prepend(#(input, tokens), tokenizer.cache)
      PAdicTokenizer(..tokenizer, cache: new_cache |> list.take(1024))
    }
  }
}

pub type TokenId = Int

pub fn encode_char(c: Char, base: Int) -> TokenId {
  char.to_int(c) % base
}

pub fn decode_char(id: TokenId, base: Int) -> Char {
  char.from_int(id % 256) |> result.unwrap
}

pub fn validate_tokens(tokens: List(TokenId), base: Int) -> Bool {
  tokens
  |> list.all(fn(t) { t >= 0 && t < base })
}

pub fn pad_tokens(tokens: List(TokenId), len: Int) -> List(TokenId) {
  case list.length(tokens) < len {
    True -> list.append(tokens, list.repeat(0, len - list.length(tokens)))
    False -> tokens |> list.take(len)
  }
}

pub fn unpad_tokens(tokens: List(TokenId)) -> List(TokenId) {
  tokens
  |> list.reverse
  |> list.drop_while(fn(t) { t == 0 })
  |> list.reverse
}

pub fn serialize_tokens(tokens: List(TokenId)) -> BitArray {
  bit_array.from_list(tokens)
}

pub fn deserialize_tokens(data: BitArray) -> List(TokenId) {
  bit_array.to_list(data)
}

pub fn hash_token_stream(tokens: List(TokenId)) -> Int {
  tokens
  |> list.fold(0, fn(acc, t) { (acc * 31 + t) % 2147483647 })
}

pub fn diff_tokens(a: List(TokenId), b: List(TokenId)) -> List(TokenId) {
  list.zip(a, b)
  |> list.map(fn(pair) {
    case pair {
      #(x, y) -> (x - y + 1000) % 1000
    }
  })
}

pub fn merge_tokens(a: List(TokenId), b: List(TokenId)) -> List(TokenId) {

const std = @import("std");
const math = std.math;
const mem = std.mem;
const bit = std.bit_set;
const Allocator = mem.Allocator;

pub const PAdicTokenizer = struct {
    base: u32,
    levels: u32,
    buffer: [8192]u8,
    cache: std.StringHashMap(std.ArrayList(u32)),

    pub fn init(allocator: Allocator, base: u32, levels: u32) !PAdicTokenizer {
        var cache = std.StringHashMap(std.ArrayList(u32)).init(allocator);
        return PAdicTokenizer{
            .base = base,
            .levels = levels,
            .buffer = undefined,
            .cache = cache,
        };
    }

    pub fn deinit(self: *PAdicTokenizer) void {
        var it = self.cache.iterator();
        while (it.next()) |entry| {
            entry.value_ptr.*.deinit();
        }
        self.cache.deinit();
    }

    pub fn normalizeUtf8(self: *PAdicTokenizer, input: []const u8) ![]u8 {
        var result = std.ArrayList(u8).init(self.cache.allocator orelse return error.NoAllocator);
        errdefer result.deinit();
        var i: usize = 0;
        while (i < input.len) : (i += 1) {
            const c = input[i];
            switch (c) {
                0xC3 => if (i + 1 < input.len) {
                    const next = input[i + 1];
                    i += 1;
                    switch (next) {
                        0xA1 => try result.appendSlice("a"),
                        0xA9 => try result.appendSlice("e"),
                        0xAD => try result.appendSlice("i"),
                        0xB3 => try result.appendSlice("o"),
                        0xBA => try result.appendSlice("u"),
                        else => try result.append(c),
                    }
                },
                0xC5 => if (i + 1 < input.len) {
                    const next = input[i + 1];
                    i += 1;
                    switch (next) {
                        0x91 => try result.appendSlice("o"),
                        0x99 => try result.appendSlice("u"),
                        else => try result.append(c),
                    }
                },
                else => try result.append(c),
            }
        }
        return try result.toOwnedSlice();
    }

    pub fn haarDecompose(self: *PAdicTokenizer, signal: []f32, level: u32, allocator: Allocator) !struct { low: []f32, high: []f32 } {
        if (signal.len == 0) return .{ .low = &[_]f32{}, .high = &[_]f32{} };
        var low = try allocator.alloc(f32, signal.len);
        var high = try allocator.alloc(f32, signal.len);
        defer allocator.free(low);
        defer allocator.free(high);
        if (signal.len == 1) {
            low[0] = signal[0] / 2.0;
            high[0] = signal[0] / 2.0;
            return .{ .low = try allocator.dupe(f32, low[0..1]), .high = try allocator.dupe(f32, high[0..1]) };
        }
        const mid = signal.len / 2;
        const left_low = try self.haarDecompose(signal[0..mid], level - 1, allocator);
        defer allocator.free(left_low.low);
        defer allocator.free(left_low.high);
        const right_low = try self.haarDecompose(signal[mid..], level - 1, allocator);
        defer allocator.free(right_low.low);
        defer allocator.free(right_low.high);
        @memcpy(low[0..mid], left_low.low);
        @memcpy(low[mid..], right_low.low);
        @memcpy(high[0..mid], left_low.high);
        @memcpy(high[mid..], right_low.high);
        return .{ .low = try allocator.dupe(f32, low), .high = try allocator.dupe(f32, high) };
    }

    pub fn walshHadamard(self: *PAdicTokenizer, input: []u8, dim: u32, allocator: Allocator) ![]u8 {
        if (dim == 1) return try allocator.dupe(u8, input);
        const half = dim / 2;
        const even = input[0..half];
        const odd = input[half..input.len];
        const even_t = try self.walshHadamard(even, half, allocator);
        defer allocator.free(even_t);
        const odd_t = try self.walshHadamard(odd, half, allocator);
        defer allocator.free(odd_t);
        var plus = try allocator.alloc(u8, dim);
        defer allocator.free(plus);
        @memcpy(plus[0..half], even_t);
        @memcpy(plus[half..dim], odd_t[0..dim - half]);
        var minus = try allocator.alloc(u8, dim);
        defer allocator.free(minus);
        @memcpy(minus[0..half], even_t);
        for (0..half) |j| {
            minus[half + j] = even_t[j] ^ odd_t[j];
        }
        var result = try allocator.alloc(u8, dim * 2);
        @memcpy(result[0..dim], plus);
        @memcpy(result[dim..], minus);
        return try allocator.dupe(u8, result);
    }

    pub fn bitplaneSlice(self: *PAdicTokenizer, data: []u8, planes: u32, allocator: Allocator) !std.ArrayList([]u8) {
        var slices = std.ArrayList([]u8).init(allocator);
        errdefer slices.deinit();
        for (0..planes) |plane| {
            var slice = try allocator.alloc(u8, data.len);
            errdefer allocator.free(slice);
            for (0..data.len) |i| {
                slice[i] = (data[i] >> @intCast(plane)) & 1;
            }
            try slices.append(try allocator.dupe(u8, slice));
        }
        return slices;
    }

    pub fn pAdicPad(self: *PAdicTokenizer, input: []u32, target_len: u32, allocator: Allocator) ![]u32 {
        if (input.len >= @as(usize, @intCast(target_len))) return try allocator.dupe(u32, input);
        const pad_len = target_len - @intCast(input.len);
        var padded = try allocator.alloc(u32, @intCast(target_len));
        errdefer allocator.free(padded);
        @memcpy(padded[0..input.len], input);
        @memset(padded[input.len..], 0);
        return padded;
    }

    pub fn polyphaseDecompose(self: *PAdicTokenizer, input: []u32, phases: u32, allocator: Allocator) !std.ArrayList([]u32) {
        var phases_list = std.ArrayList([]u32).init(allocator);
        errdefer phases_list.deinit();
        for (0..phases) |phase| {
            var phase_data = std.ArrayList(u32).init(allocator);
            errdefer phase_data.deinit();
            for (input, 0..) |val, idx| {
                if (@rem(idx, phases) == phase) try phase_data.append(val);
            }
            try phases_list.append(try phase_data.toOwnedSlice());
        }
        return phases_list;
    }

    pub fn tokenize(self: *PAdicTokenizer, input: []const u8, allocator: Allocator) ![]u32 {
        const normalized = try self.normalizeUtf8(input);
        defer allocator.free(normalized);
        var codes = std.ArrayList(u32).init(allocator);
        defer codes.deinit();
        for (normalized) |c| {
            try codes.append(@intCast(c % self.base));
        }
        var signal = try allocator.alloc(f32, codes.items.len);
        defer allocator.free(signal);
        for (codes.items, 0..) |code, j| {
            signal[j] = @floatFromInt(code);
        }
        const haar = try self.haarDecompose(signal, self.levels, allocator);
        defer allocator.free(haar.low);
        defer allocator.free(haar.high);
        var wavelet_codes = std.ArrayList(u32).init(allocator);
        defer wavelet_codes.deinit();
        for (haar.high) |v| {
            try wavelet_codes.append(@intCast(@round(v) % self.base));
        }
        const bytes = try std.mem.asBytes(&wavelet_codes.items);
        const bitplanes = try self.bitplaneSlice(bytes, 8, allocator);
        defer for (bitplanes.items) |bp| allocator.free(bp);
        const poly = try self.polyphaseDecompose(bitplanes.items[0], 128, allocator);
        defer for (poly.items) |p| allocator.free(p);
        const padded = try self.pAdicPad(poly.items[0], 131072, allocator);
        defer allocator.free(padded);
        return try allocator.dupe(u32, padded);
    }

    pub fn detokenize(self: *PAdicTokenizer, tokens: []const u32, allocator: Allocator) ![]u8 {
        var poly_recon = std.ArrayList(u32).init(allocator);
        defer poly_recon.deinit();
        for (0..128) |phase| {
            for (0..1024) |idx| {
                const pos = phase + idx * 128;
                if (pos < tokens.len) try poly_recon.append(tokens[pos]);
            }
        }
        var bitplanes = try allocator.alloc([]u8, 8);
        defer allocator.free(bitplanes);
        for (0..8) |plane| {
            var plane_data = try allocator.alloc(u8, poly_recon.items.len);
            defer allocator.free(plane_data);
            for (poly_recon.items, 0..) |val, i| {
                plane_data[i] = @intCast((val >> plane) & 1);
            }
            bitplanes[plane] = try allocator.dupe(u8, plane_data);
        }
        const wavelet_inv = try self.walshHadamard(bitplanes[0], @intCast(poly_recon.items.len), allocator);
        defer allocator.free(wavelet_inv);
        var inv_haar = try allocator.alloc(f32, wavelet_inv.len);
        defer allocator.free(inv_haar);
        for (wavelet_inv, 0..) |val, i| {
            inv_haar[i] = @as(f32, @floatFromInt(val));
        }
        const haar_inv = try self.haarDecompose(inv_haar, self.levels, allocator);
        defer allocator.free(haar_inv.low);
        defer allocator.free(haar_inv.high);
        var chars = std.ArrayList(u8).init(allocator);
        defer chars.deinit();
        for (haar_inv.low) |v| {
            const val = @intCast(@round(v));
            if (val > 0 and val < 256) try chars.append(@intCast(val));
        }
        return try chars.toOwnedSlice();
    }

    pub fn cacheTokenize(self: *PAdicTokenizer, input: []const u8, allocator: Allocator) !void {
        if (self.cache.contains(input)) return;
        const tokens = try self.tokenize(input, allocator);
        var list = std.ArrayList(u32).init(allocator);
        try list.appendSlice(tokens);
        try self.cache.put(try allocator.dupe(u8, input), list);
        allocator.free(tokens);
    }

    pub fn getFromCache(self: *PAdicTokenizer, input: []const u8) ?[]u32 {
        if (self.cache.getPtr(input)) |entry| {
            return entry.items.slice();
        }
        return null;
    }
};

pub fn main() !void {
    var gpa = std.heap.GeneralPurposeAllocator(.{}){};
    defer _ = gpa.deinit();
    const allocator = gpa.allocator();
    var tokenizer = try PAdicTokenizer.init(allocator, 5, 12);
    defer tokenizer.deinit();
    const input = "hello world";
    try tokenizer.cacheTokenize(input, allocator);
    if (tokenizer.getFromCache(input)) |tokens| {
        std.debug.print("Tokens: {d}\n", .{tokens});
        const detok = try tokenizer.detokenize(tokens, allocator);
        defer allocator.free(detok);
        std.debug.print("Detokenized: {s}\n", .{detok});
    }
}

function haar_wavelet_decompose(signal::Vector{Float64}, level::Int)::Tuple{Vector{Float64}, Vector{Float64}}
    if isempty(signal)

    elseif length(signal) == 1
        return [signal[1]/2], [signal[1]/2]
    else
        mid = length(signal) ÷ 2
        left = signal[1:mid]
        right = signal[mid+1:end]
        low_left, high_left = haar_wavelet_decompose(left, level - 1)
        low_right, high_right = haar_wavelet_decompose(right, level - 1)
        low = vcat(low_left, low_right)
        high = vcat(high_left, high_right)
        return low, high
    end

        return copy(input)
    end
    half = dim ÷ 2
    even = input[1:2:end]
    odd = input[2:2:end]
    even_t = walsh_hadamard_transform(even, half)
    odd_t = walsh_hadamard_transform(odd, half)
    plus = vcat(even_t, odd_t)
    minus = vcat(even_t, xor.(even_t, odd_t))

    end

        codes = map(g -> length(string(g)) % tokenizer.base, graphemes)
        signal = Float64.(codes)
        _, wavelet = haar_wavelet_decompose(signal, tokenizer.levels)

        new_cache[input] = tokens

    end

-- NTT Mix Kernel for modular multiplication and convolution
-- Entry: ntt_mix (xs: [n]i32) (ws: [n]i32) (mod: i32) -> [n]i32
entry ntt_mix [n] (xs: [n]i32) (ws: [n]i32) (mod_: i32) =
  let butterfly [k] (a: i32) (b: i32) (w: i32) =
    let t = (b * w) % mod_
    in (a + t, a - t)
  in loop xs for i < log2 n do
    let step = 1 << i
    let half = step / 2
    in iota n |> map fn j =>
      let idx1 = j
      let idx2 = idx1 ^ half
      let w_idx = (j / step) * half
      let w = ws[w_idx]
      let a = xs[idx1]
      let b = xs[idx2]
      let (na, nb) = butterfly a b w
      in scatter (xs with [idx1] = na % mod_) [idx2] = nb % mod_
  in xs

-- Precompute primitive roots for NTT
entry precompute_primitives [logn] (mod_: i32) =
  let g = 3i32 -- primitive root for mod 2^32-1 approx
  in loop (iota logn |> map fn _ => 1i32) for lvl < logn do
    let omega = pow g (1 << (logn - lvl - 1)) mod_
    in map fn w => (w * omega) % mod_ previous

-- Modular exponentiation
let pow (base: i32) (exp: i32) (mod_: i32) =
  loop base for _ < 32 do
    if exp & 1 == 1 then
      (base * base) % mod_
    else base
  in if exp > 0 then pow ((base * base) % mod_) (exp >> 1) mod_ else 1

-- Inverse NTT
entry intt_mix [n] (xs: [n]i32) (ws: [n]i32) (mod_: i32) (ninv: i32) =
  let ibutterfly [k] (a: i32) (b: i32) (w: i32) =
    let t = (b * w) % mod_
    in (a + t, a - t)
  in let y = ntt_mix xs (map fn w => mod_ - w ws) mod_
  in map fn x => (x * ninv) % mod_ y

-- Batch NTT for multiple sequences
entry batch_ntt [batch][n] (xss: [batch][n]i32) (ws: [n]i32) (mod_: i32) =
  map fn xs => ntt_mix xs ws mod_ xss

-- Convolution via NTT
entry ntt_convolve [n] (a: [n]i32) (b: [n]i32) (mod_: i32) (ws: [n]i32) (ninv: i32) =
  let a_ntt = ntt_mix (pad a n) ws mod_
  let b_ntt = ntt_mix (pad b n) ws mod_
  let prod = map fn (x,y) => (x * y) % mod_ (zip a_ntt b_ntt)
  let res = intt_mix prod ws mod_ ninv
  in unpad res n

-- Pad to power of 2
let pad [n] (xs: [n]i32) (target: i32) =
  xs ++ replicate (target - n) 0i32

let unpad [n] (xs: [n]i32) (target: i32) =
  take target xs

-- Log2 approximation
let log2 (x: i32) = 31 - clz (x - 1)

-- Count leading zeros
let clz (x: i32) = 32 - bitwidth x

-- Bitwidth
let bitwidth (x: i32) = if x == 0 then 0 else 32 - clz (x - 1)

-- Replicate for batching
entry replicate_batch [batch][n] (xs: [n]i32) = replicate batch xs

-- Scatter-gather for distributed
entry scatter_gather [n] (xs: [n]i32) (indices: [n]i32) (mod_: i32) =
  scatter (replicate n 0i32) indices xs

-- Gather from indices
entry gather_scatter [n] (xs: [n]i32) (indices: [n]i32) =
  map fn i => unsafe xs[indices[i]] indices

-- Modular inverse using Fermat if prime
entry mod_inverse (a: i32) (mod_: i32) = pow a (mod_ - 2) mod_

-- Multi-primitive NTT for larger mods
entry multi_primitive_ntt [n] (xs: [n]i32) (prims: [log2 n]i32) (mod_: i32) =
  fold primitives for prim in prims do
    ntt_mix xs (precompute_primitives prim mod_) mod_

-- Twiddle factor generation
let twiddles [logn] (g: i32) (mod_: i32) =
  scanl fn (acc, lvl) => (acc * pow g (1 << lvl) mod_) % mod_ (1i32, iota logn)

-- Bit-reverse permutation
entry bit_reverse [n] (xs: [n]i32) =
  let rev = map fn i => bitreverse i (log2 n) (iota n)
  in scatter xs rev

let bitreverse (x: i32) (bits: i32) =
  fold (0i32, x) for b < bits do
    let (rev, rem) = (rev * 2 + rem % 2, rem / 2)
    in (rev, rem)

-- Cooley-Tukey radix-2 NTT
entry radix2_ntt [n] (xs: [n]i32) (omega: i32) (mod_: i32) =
  let bitrev_xs = bit_reverse xs
  in loop bitrev_xs for s < log2 n do
    let m = 1 << s
    let wm = pow omega (n / m) mod_
    let w = 1i32
    in uncurry (fn start (group: [m]i32) =>
      let pairs = partition (2, group)
      let (evens, odds) = unzip pairs
      let twid = replicate (m/2) w
      let ts = map fn (o, t) => (o * t) % mod_ (zip odds twid)
      let us = map fn (e, t) => (e + t) % mod_ (zip evens ts)
      let vs = map fn (e, t) => (e - t + mod_) % mod_ (zip evens ts)
      in interleave us vs) (unzip (partition (m, iota n) |> map fn block_start => 
        take m (drop block_start bitrev_xs)))

-- Optimized for power-of-2
entry power2_ntt [n] (xs: [n]i32) (mod_: i32) =

pub const NttMix = struct {
    const Self = @This();

    mod: u64,
    n: u64,
    ws: []u64,
    allocator: mem.Allocator,

    pub fn init(allocator: mem.Allocator, n: u64, mod_: u64) !Self {
        var ws = try allocator.alloc(u64, @intCast(n));
        errdefer allocator.free(ws);
        var g: u64 = 3;
        var omega: u64 = 1;
        for (0..@intCast(n / 2)) |i| {
            ws[i] = omega;
            omega = (omega * g) % mod_;
        }
        return Self{
            .mod = mod_,
            .n = n,
            .ws = ws,
            .allocator = allocator,
        };
    }

    pub fn deinit(self: *Self) void {
        self.allocator.free(self.ws);
    }

    pub fn butterfly(self: *const Self, a: u64, b: u64, w: u64) struct { u64, u64 } {
        const t = (b * w) % self.mod;
        return .{ (a + t) % self.mod, (a + self.mod - t) % self.mod };
    }

    pub fn ntt(self: *const Self, xs: []u64) void {
        var logn = std.math.log2_int(u64, self.n);
        var i: u64 = 0;
        while (i < logn) : (i += 1) {
            const step = @as(u64, 1) << i;
            const half = step / 2;
            var j: u64 = 0;
            while (j < self.n) : (j += 1) {
                const idx1 = j;
                const idx2 = idx1 ^ half;
                if (idx1 < idx2) {
                    const w_idx = (j / step) * half;
                    const w = self.ws[@intCast(w_idx)];
                    const a = xs[@intCast(idx1)];
                    const b = xs[@intCast(idx2)];
                    const res = self.butterfly(a, b, w);
                    xs[@intCast(idx1)] = res[0];
                    xs[@intCast(idx2)] = res[1];
                }
            }
        }
    }

    pub fn intt(self: *const Self, xs: []u64, ninv: u64) void {
        var logn = std.math.log2_int(u64, self.n);
        for (0..self.ws.len) |k| {
            self.ws[k] = (self.mod - self.ws[k]) % self.mod;
        }
        self.ntt(xs);
        for (0..xs.len) |i| {
            xs[i] = (xs[i] * ninv) % self.mod;
        }
    }

    pub fn convolve(self: *const Self, a: []const u64, b: []const u64, ninv: u64, out: []u64) !void {
        const nn = self.n;
        var a_pad = try self.allocator.alloc(u64, @intCast(nn));
        defer self.allocator.free(a_pad);
        @memset(a_pad, 0);
        const min_a = @min(a.len, @intCast(nn));
        @memcpy(a_pad[0..min_a], a[0..min_a]);
        var b_pad = try self.allocator.alloc(u64, @intCast(nn));
        defer self.allocator.free(b_pad);
        @memset(b_pad, 0);
        const min_b = @min(b.len, @intCast(nn));
        @memcpy(b_pad[0..min_b], b[0..min_b]);
        self.ntt(a_pad);
        self.ntt(b_pad);
        for (0..@intCast(nn)) |i| {
            a_pad[i] = (a_pad[i] * b_pad[i]) % self.mod;
        }
        self.intt(a_pad, ninv);
        const out_len = @min(a.len + b.len - 1, out.len);
        @memcpy(out[0..out_len], a_pad[0..out_len]);
    }

    var res: u64 = 1;
    var b = base % mod_;
    var e = exp;

        if (e & 1 == 1) {
            res = math.mulMod(res, b, mod_);
        }
        b = math.mulMod(b, b, mod_);
    }
    return res;

const math = std.math;

pub const WaveletConv = struct {
    const Self = @This();

    levels: u32,
    filters: []f64,
    allocator: mem.Allocator,

    pub fn init(allocator: mem.Allocator, levels: u32) !Self {
        var filters = try allocator.alloc(f64, 16);
        errdefer allocator.free(filters);
        const lo_d4 = [_]f64{ 0.4829629131445341, 0.8365163037378079, 0.2241438680420134, -0.1294095225512604 };
        const hi_d4 = [_]f64{ -0.1294095225512604, -0.2241438680420134, 0.8365163037378079, -0.4829629131445341 };
        @memcpy(filters[0..4], &lo_d4);
        @memcpy(filters[4..8], &hi_d4);
        @memset(filters[8..16], 0.0);
        return Self{
            .levels = levels,
            .filters = filters,
            .allocator = allocator,
        };
    }

    pub fn deinit(self: *Self) void {
        self.allocator.free(self.filters);
    }

    fn convolve(self: *const Self, sig: []const f64, filt: []const f64, allocator: mem.Allocator) ![]f64 {
        const n = sig.len;
        const m = filt.len;
        const pad_len = m / 2;
        var padded = try allocator.alloc(f64, n + 2 * pad_len);
        defer allocator.free(padded);
        @memset(padded, 0.0);
        @memcpy(padded[pad_len..pad_len + n], sig);
        var result = try allocator.alloc(f64, n);
        errdefer allocator.free(result);
        for (0..n) |i| {
            var sum: f64 = 0.0;
            for (0..m) |j| {
                const idx = i + j;
                if (idx < padded.len) {
                    sum += padded[idx] * filt[j];
                }
            }
            result[i] = sum;
        }
        return result;
    }

    fn downsample(self: *const Self, x: []const f64, factor: u32) ![]f64 {
        const new_len = x.len / @intCast(factor);
        var ds = try self.allocator.alloc(f64, new_len);
        errdefer self.allocator.free(ds);
        for (0..new_len) |i| {
            ds[i] = x[i * @intCast(factor)];
        }
        return ds;
    }

    pub fn scattering(self: *const Self, signal: []f64) ![]f64 {
        var current = try self.convolve(signal, self.filters[0..4], self.allocator);
        defer self.allocator.free(current);
        var scalogram = try self.allocator.alloc(f64, current.len);
        errdefer self.allocator.free(scalogram);
        for (0..self.levels) |_| {
            var abs_current = try self.allocator.alloc(f64, current.len);
            defer self.allocator.free(abs_current);
            for (0..current.len) |i| {
                abs_current[i] = math.fabs(current[i]);
            }
            current = try self.downsample(abs_current, 2);
        }
        @memcpy(scalogram, current);
        return scalogram;
    }
};

module KanParam

export kan_layer, spline_eval, b_spline_basis, generate_splines, spectral_regularization

function kan_layer(input::Vector{Float64}, coeffs::Matrix{Float64}, grid::Int, knots::Vector{Float64})::Vector{Float64}
    dim = length(input)
    output = zeros(dim)
    for d = 1:dim
        sum = 0.0
        for g = 1:grid
            basis = b_spline_basis(input[d], knots, 3)
            sum += basis[g] * coeffs[d, g]
        end
        output[d] = tanh(sum)
    end
    output
end

function spline_eval(x::Float64, coeffs::Vector{Float64}, knots::Vector{Float64}, degree::Int)::Float64
    sum = 0.0
    nk = length(knots) - degree - 1
    for i = 1:nk
        basis = b_spline_basis(x, knots, degree)
        sum += basis[i] * coeffs[i]
    end
    sum
end

function b_spline_basis(x::Float64, knots::Vector{Float64}, degree::Int)::Vector{Float64}
    if degree == 0
        basis = zeros(length(knots)-1)
        for i = 1:length(knots)-1
            if knots[i] <= x < knots[i+1]
                basis[i] = 1.0
            end
        end
        return basis
    end
    prev_basis = b_spline_basis(x, knots, degree - 1)
    basis = zeros(length(prev_basis))
    for i = 1:length(basis)
        left_num = (knots[i+degree] - knots[i] != 0) ? (x - knots[i]) / (knots[i+degree] - knots[i]) : 0.0
        right_num = (knots[i+degree+1] - knots[i+1] != 0) ? (knots[i+degree+1] - x) / (knots[i+degree+1] - knots[i+1]) : 0.0
        left_basis = b_spline_basis(x, knots[1:i+degree-1], degree-1)
        right_basis = b_spline_basis(x, knots[2:i+degree], degree-1)
        basis[i] = left_num * left_basis[i] + right_num * right_basis[i-1]
    end
    basis
end

function generate_splines(dim::Int, grid::Int, init_scale::Float64)::Matrix{Float64}
    knots = generate_knots(grid)
    coeffs = init_scale * randn(dim, grid)
    coeffs, knots
end

function generate_knots(grid::Int)::Vector{Float64}
    num_knots = grid + 4
    [i / (grid - 1) for i = 0:num_knots-1]
end

function spectral_regularization(coeffs::Matrix{Float64}, lambda::Float64)::Matrix{Float64}
    dim, grid = size(coeffs)
    norm = sqrt(sum(coeffs.^2))
    if norm > 1.0
        scale = (1.0 - lambda) / norm
        coeffs .* scale
    else
        coeffs
    end
end

function kan_block(input::Matrix{Float64}, coeffs::Array{Float64,3}, grid::Int, knots::Vector{Float64})::Matrix{Float64}
    batch, dim = size(input)
    output = zeros(batch, dim)
    for b = 1:batch
        for d = 1:dim
            sum = 0.0
            for g = 1:grid
                basis = b_spline_basis(input[b,d], knots, 3)
                sum += basis[g] * coeffs[b,d,g]
            end
            output[b,d] = tanh(sum)
        end
    end
    output
end

function batch_spline_eval(inputs::Matrix{Float64}, coeffs::Matrix{Float64}, knots::Vector{Float64}, degree::Int)::Matrix{Float64}
    batch, dim = size(inputs)
    outputs = zeros(batch, dim)
    for b = 1:batch
        for d = 1:dim
            outputs[b,d] = spline_eval(inputs[b,d], coeffs[d,:], knots, degree)
        end
    end
    outputs
end

function update_splines(coeffs::Matrix{Float64}, grads::Matrix{Float64}, lr::Float64)::Matrix{Float64}
    coeffs .- lr .* grads
end

function compute_grads(input::Vector{Float64}, output::Vector{Float64}, target::Vector{Float64}, coeffs::Matrix{Float64}, knots::Vector{Float64})::Matrix{Float64}
    dim, grid = size(coeffs)
    grads = zeros(dim, grid)
    for d = 1:dim
        for g = 1:grid
            basis = b_spline_basis(input[d], knots, 3)
            deriv_basis = derivative_basis(basis, knots, input[d], 3)
            grads[d,g] = deriv_basis[g] * (output[d] - target[d]) * (1 - output[d]^2)
        end
    end
    grads
end

function derivative_basis(basis::Vector{Float64}, knots::Vector{Float64}, x::Float64, degree::Int)::Vector{Float64}
    deriv = zeros(length(basis))
    for i = 1:length(basis)
        if i > 1 && i < length(basis)
            denom_left = knots[i+degree] - knots[i]
            denom_right = knots[i+degree+1] - knots[i+1]
            if denom_left != 0
                deriv[i] += degree * (basis[i] / denom_left)
            end
            if denom_right != 0
                deriv[i-1] -= degree * (basis[i] / denom_right)
            end
        end
    end
    deriv
end
